articles.title_en: Economic Activity across Space: A Supply and Demand Approach
articles.title_cn: 空间经济活动：一种供需方法
articles.abstract_en: What do recent advances in economic geography teach us about the spatial distribution of economic activity? We show that the equilibrium distribution of economic activity can be determined simply by the intersection of labor supply and demand curves. We discuss how to estimate these curves and highlight the importance of global geography—the connections between locations through the trading network—in determining how various policy relevant changes to geography shape the spatial economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济地理学的最新进展告诉我们关于经济活动空间分布的哪些信息？我们表明，经济活动的均衡分布可以简单地由劳动力供给和需求曲线的交点决定。我们讨论了如何估计这些曲线，并强调了全球地理——即通过贸易网络连接各地——在决定各种与政策相关的地理变化如何塑造空间经济中的重要性。

articles.title_en: Neighborhood Change, Gentrification, and the Urbanization of College Graduates
articles.title_cn: 社区变迁、绅士化与大学毕业生的城市化
articles.abstract_en: We study changing trends in within-city sorting by education over the last 40 years. We show that neighborhoods closest to the centers of large US cities rose from having the lowest levels of college attainment in 1980 to the highest in 2017. We discuss the determinants of changes in sorting patterns, focusing on the role of transportation technology and income growth. We outline various consequences of the recent urbanization of college graduates on neighborhood amenities, house prices, and segregation. We highlight the tendency of college graduates to cluster into select central neighborhoods, likely limiting opportunities for interactions across educational lines.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了过去40年间城市内按教育程度划分的居住分异趋势的变化。我们表明，在1980年，美国大城市中心附近社区的大学学历比例最低，而到2017年则升至最高。我们讨论了居住分异模式变化的决定因素，重点关注交通技术和收入增长的作用。我们概述了近年来大学毕业生城市化对社区便利设施、房价和隔离的各种影响。我们强调大学毕业生倾向于聚集在选定的中心社区，这可能限制了不同教育背景人群之间的互动机会。

articles.title_en: Constraints on City and Neighborhood Growth: The Central Role of Housing Supply
articles.title_cn: 城市与社区增长的约束：住房供给的核心作用
articles.abstract_en: The US urban population increased by almost 50 percent between 1980 and 2020, with this growth heavily concentrated in the Sun Belt and at the fringes of metropolitan areas. This paper considers the role of housing supply in shaping the growth of cities and neighborhoods. Housing supply constraints have meant that demand growth has increasingly manifested as price growth rather than as increases in housing units or population in larger and denser metropolitan areas and neighborhoods. New housing is provided at increasingly higher cost in areas that have higher intensity of existing development and more restrictive regulatory environments. Both forces have strengthened over time, making quantity supplied less responsive to growing demand, driving housing price growth in many areas, and pushing housing quantity growth further out into urban fringes. As a result of such pressures on the cost of new construction, the US has recently experienced more rapid price growth and a declining influence of new construction on the housing stock.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国城市人口在1980年至2020年间增长了近50%，且这一增长高度集中于阳光地带和大都市区的边缘地带。本文探讨了住房供给在塑造城市和社区增长中的作用。住房供给约束意味着，需求增长日益表现为价格上涨，而非在较大且较密集的大都市区和社区中住房单元或人口的增加。在现有开发强度较高且监管环境更为严格的地区，新住房的提供成本日益上升。这两种力量随时间推移而增强，使得供给数量对增长需求的响应减弱，推动了许多地区的住房价格上涨，并将住房数量增长进一步推向城市边缘。由于新建设成本面临此类压力，美国近期经历了更快的价格上涨，且新建设对住房存量的影响有所下降。

articles.title_en: Quantitative Urban Models: From Theory to Data
articles.title_cn: 定量城市模型：从理论到数据
articles.abstract_en: Economic activity is highly unevenly distributed within cities, as reflected in the concentration of economic functions in specific locations, such as finance in the Square Mile in London. The extent to which this concentration reflects natural advantages versus agglomeration forces is central to a range of public policy issues, including the impact of local taxation and transport infrastructure improvements. This paper reviews recent quantitative urban models, which incorporate both differences in natural advantages and agglomeration forces, and can be taken directly to observed data on cities. We show that these models can be used to estimate the strength of agglomeration forces and evaluate the impact of transportation infrastructure improvements on welfare and the spatial distribution of economic activity.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济活动在城市内部的分布极不均匀，这体现在经济功能集中于特定地点，例如伦敦金融城（Square Mile）的金融业。这种集中程度在多大程度上反映了自然优势与集聚力量的对比，是许多公共政策问题的核心，包括地方税收和交通基础设施改善的影响。本文回顾了近期定量城市模型，这些模型既包含了自然优势的差异，也包含了集聚力量，并且可以直接应用于观测到的城市数据。我们表明，这些模型可以用来估计集聚力量的强度，并评估交通基础设施改善对福利和经济活动空间分布的影响。

articles.title_en: Achieving Universal Health Insurance Coverage in the United States: Addressing Market Failures or Providing a Social Floor?
articles.title_cn: 实现美国全民健康保险覆盖：应对市场失灵还是提供社会底线？
articles.abstract_en: The United States spends substantially more on health care than most developed countries, yet leaves a greater share of the population uninsured. We argue that incremental insurance expansions focused on addressing market failures will propagate inefficiencies and will fail to facilitate the active policy decisions needed to achieve socially optimal coverage. By instead defining a basic bundle of services that is publicly financed for all, while allowing individuals to purchase additional coverage, policymakers could both expand coverage and maintain incentives for innovation, ensuring universal access to innovative care in an affordable system.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国在医疗保健上的支出远高于大多数发达国家，但仍有更大比例的人口没有保险。我们认为，专注于解决市场失灵的渐进式保险扩展将传播低效率，并且无法促进实现社会最优覆盖所需的积极政策决策。相反，通过定义一套由公共财政为所有人提供的基本服务包，同时允许个人购买额外保险，政策制定者既可以扩大覆盖范围，又可以保持创新激励，确保在可负担的系统中实现全民获得创新医疗的机会。

articles.title_en: The Prices in the Crises: What We Are Learning from 20 Years of Health Insurance in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
articles.title_cn: 危机中的价格：我们从低收入和中等收入国家20年健康保险中学到了什么
articles.abstract_en: Governments in many low- and middle-income countries are developing health insurance products as a complement to tax-funded, subsidized provision of healthcare through publicly-operated facilities. We discuss two rationales for this transition. First, health insurance would boost fiscal revenues for healthcare, as post-treatment out-of-pocket payments to providers would be replaced by pre-treatment insurance premia to health ministries. Second, increased patient choice and carefully designed physician reimbursements would increase quality in the healthcare sector. Our essay shows that, at best, these objectives have only been partially met. Despite evidence that health insurance has provided financial protection, consumers are not willing to pay for unsubsidized premia. Health outcomes have not improved despite an increase in utilization. We argue that this is not because there was no room to improve the quality of care but because behavioral responses among healthcare providers have systematically undermined the objectives of these insurance schemes.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多低收入和中等收入国家的政府正在开发健康保险产品，作为通过公共运营设施提供税收资助、补贴医疗服务的补充。我们讨论了这一转变的两个理由。首先，健康保险将增加医疗保健的财政收入，因为治疗后的自付费用将被治疗前的保险费支付给卫生部门所取代。其次，增加患者选择和精心设计的医生报销将提高医疗保健部门的质量。我们的文章表明，这些目标充其量只部分实现。尽管有证据表明健康保险提供了财务保护，但消费者不愿为未补贴的保费付费。尽管利用率增加，健康结果并未改善。我们认为，这并不是因为没有改善护理质量的空间，而是因为医疗服务提供者的行为反应系统性地削弱了这些保险计划的目标。

articles.title_en: America’s Continuing Struggle with Mental Illnesses: Economic Considerations
articles.title_cn: 美国与精神疾病的持续斗争：经济考量
articles.abstract_en: Mental illnesses affect roughly 20 percent of the US population. Like other health conditions, mental illnesses impose costs on individuals; they also generate costs that extend to family members and the larger society. Care for mental illnesses has evolved quite differently from the rest of health care sector. While medical care in general has seen major advances in the technology of treatment this has not been the case to the same extent for the treatment of mental illnesses. Relative to other illnesses, the cost of care for mental illnesses has grown more slowly and the social cost of illness has grown more rapidly. In this essay we offer evidence about the forces underpinning these patterns and emphasize the challenges stemming from the heterogeneity of mental illnesses. We examine institutions and rationing mechanisms that affect the ability to make appropriate matches between clinical problems and treatments. We conclude with a review of implications for policy and economic research.
articles.abstract_cn: 精神疾病影响着大约20%的美国人口。与其他健康状况一样，精神疾病给个人带来成本；它们也产生延伸到家庭成员和更大社会的成本。精神疾病的护理演变与医疗保健部门的其他部分截然不同。虽然总体医疗护理在治疗技术方面取得了重大进步，但精神疾病治疗的情况并非如此。相对于其他疾病，精神疾病的护理成本增长较慢，而疾病的社会成本增长较快。在这篇文章中，我们提供了关于支撑这些模式的力量的证据，并强调了源于精神疾病异质性的挑战。我们考察了影响临床问题与治疗之间适当匹配能力的制度和配给机制。最后，我们回顾了对政策和经济学研究的影响。

articles.title_en: Depression and Loneliness among the Elderly in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
articles.title_cn: 低收入和中等收入国家老年人的抑郁与孤独感
articles.abstract_en: We combine data from longitudinal surveys in seven low- and middle-income countries (plus the United States for comparison) to document that depressive symptoms among those aged 55 and above are prevalent in those countries and, unlike in the United States, increase sharply with age. Depressive symptoms in one survey wave are associated with a greater decline in ability to carry out basic daily activities and a higher probability of death in the next wave. Using additional data from a panel survey we conducted in Tamil Nadu with a focus on elderly living alone, we document that social isolation, poverty, and physical health challenges are strongly correlated with depression. We discuss potential policy interventions in these three domains, including some results from our randomized control trials in the Tamil Nadu sample.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们结合七个低收入和中等收入国家（以及美国作为比较）的纵向调查数据，记录了这些国家中55岁及以上老年人的抑郁症状普遍存在，并且与美国不同，这些症状随年龄增长而急剧增加。某一调查波次中的抑郁症状与下一波次中基本日常活动能力下降幅度更大以及死亡概率更高相关。利用我们在泰米尔纳德邦进行的一项针对独居老年人的小组调查的额外数据，我们记录了社会隔离、贫困和身体健康挑战与抑郁密切相关。我们讨论了这三个领域的潜在政策干预措施，包括我们在泰米尔纳德邦样本中进行的随机对照试验的一些结果。

articles.title_en: An Introductory Guide to Event Study Models
articles.title_cn: 事件研究模型入门指南
articles.abstract_en: The event study model is a powerful econometric tool used for the purpose of estimating dynamic treatment effects. One of its most appealing features is that it provides a built-in graphical summary of results, which can reveal rich patterns of behavior. Another value of the picture is the estimated pre-event pseudo-“effects,” which provide a type of placebo test. In this essay I aim to provide a framework for a shared understanding of these models. There are several (sometimes subtle) decisions and choices faced by users of these models, and I offer guidance for these decisions.
articles.abstract_cn: 事件研究模型是一种强大的计量经济学工具，用于估计动态处理效应。其最吸引人的特点之一是它提供了内置的图形化结果摘要，可以揭示丰富的行为模式。该图形的另一个价值在于估计的事件前伪“效应”，这提供了一种安慰剂检验。在本文中，我旨在为这些模型的共同理解提供一个框架。这些模型的使用者面临几个（有时是微妙的）决策和选择，我为这些决策提供指导。

articles.title_en: Retrospectives: Edgar Sydenstricker: Household Equivalence Scales and the Causes of Pellagra
articles.title_cn: 回顾：埃德加·西登斯特里克：家庭等值规模与糙皮病的成因
articles.abstract_en: In the early part of the 20 th century the disease pellagra, now almost unknown, affected and killed thousands of people in the United States. Some claimed it was an infection, while others maintained it was due to a dietary deficiency. The economist Edgar Sydenstricker (1881-1936), who was a member of a US Public Health Service team examining the disease, argued it was critical to understand how pellagra varied by levels of income. Collecting survey data, he realized equivalence scales were needed to adjust household incomes. His research demonstrated that there was a strong negative correlation between the incidence of pellagra and equivalized household income. Further analysis of the dietary differences between households suggested that a dietary deficiency associated to a restricted availability of animal protein food was the cause of pellagra. This was confirmed more than a decade later when a deficiency of vitamin B-3 was identified as the cause.
articles.abstract_cn: 在20世纪初，糙皮病这种如今几乎不为人知的疾病影响了美国成千上万的人并导致他们死亡。一些人声称这是一种感染，而另一些人则坚持认为这是由于饮食缺乏所致。经济学家埃德加·西登斯特里克（1881-1936）是美国公共卫生服务团队中研究该疾病的成员，他认为理解糙皮病如何随收入水平变化至关重要。通过收集调查数据，他意识到需要等值规模来调整家庭收入。他的研究表明，糙皮病的发病率与等值化家庭收入之间存在强烈的负相关。对家庭间饮食差异的进一步分析表明，与动物蛋白食品供应受限相关的饮食缺乏是糙皮病的病因。十多年后，当维生素B-3缺乏被确定为病因时，这一点得到了证实。
